frequency_question: How often do states with high will successfully initiate domestic production of complex foreign military systems within a 3-to-4-year window?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign states initiating domestic manufacturing of sophisticated guided missiles or advanced airframes originally designed abroad during wartime. Excludes simple ammunition or small arms manufacturing.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic production of Stugna-P and modernization lines
Ukraine domestic artillery shell manufacturing (155mm initiatives)
Iran domestic reverse-engineering and production of advanced drone lines (Shahed series)
Taiwan Hsiung Feng missile production scaling

coverage_note: 5 named cases representing modern sovereign attempts to localize high-tech missile or major defense hardware under duress.
known_gaps: Class is small because high-end cruise missile localization is rare; relies on broader advanced munition localization analogs.
validity_reason: Technological complexity and supply chain constraints remain relatively constant over the medium term.
